<!-- pulse-interactive-handover -->
## Worker takeover — no interactive session activity for 12h

This `origin:interactive` PR has been idle past the handover threshold. The pulse is now routing it through the worker pipeline to drive it to merge:

- CI failures → routed to linked issue for worker re-dispatch
- Merge conflicts → routed to linked issue for worker re-dispatch
- Review feedback → routed to linked issue for worker re-dispatch
- Once all required checks pass: auto-approved + admin-merged (collaborator author only)

### Reclaiming interactively

If you return and want to drive this PR yourself, run in a terminal (not a chat session):

```bash
gh issue edit 4 --repo ccastle13/bct2-website --remove-label origin:worker-takeover
interactive-session-helper.sh claim <linked-issue-number> ccastle13/bct2-website
```

Any worker mid-flight will self-terminate on the next pulse cycle (combined assignee + status signal via `dispatch-dedup-helper.sh`).

### Opting out permanently

Add the `no-takeover` label to this PR at any time. The routing gates will skip it.

<sub>Posted once per PR by `pulse-merge-conflict.sh` (t2189).</sub>

## Summary
Resync `.github/workflows/issue-triage-gate.yml` to the canonical aidevops caller template
(reusable-workflow pattern, GH#20649 + GH#20727).
**Classification before**: `NO-WORKFLOW`
**Ref**: `@main`
## Why
The aidevops framework ships managed GitHub Actions workflows as reusable
workflows. Downstream repos carry ~45-line callers that delegate all logic
to the configured aidevops reusable workflow repository/ref.
This PR brings this repo in line with the canonical template, eliminating
drift and unblocking automatic updates when the framework evolves.
## How to verify
After merge, trigger an event matching the workflow triggers. Framework
scripts are fetched at runtime via a secondary checkout — no
`.agents/scripts/` files are needed in this repo.
## Rollback
If the workflow breaks, revert this PR. The previous workflow is preserved
in git history at the parent commit.
Generated by: `aidevops sync-workflows --apply` (see marcusquinn/aidevops#20649).
